purpose: Major-revision evidence added after simulated peer review; existing S1-S4 artifacts remain immutable.

seeds.selection: fixed before S5B outcomes; seven added seeds are not selected from results

continuous_within_range.parameter_design: first 12000 points of a scrambled Sobol(2) design, linearly mapped to beta and gamma/eta bounds; the same parameter points are used for every n
continuous_within_range.split: point_id mod 5: test=fold, validation=(fold+1) mod 5, remaining train

training.input_scaler: per-position mean/sd fit on training rows only
training.P_equal: three-output legal parameterization; equal-weight direct parameter loss
training.Q_param: same three-output model and decoder as P_equal; relative squared x_R loss
training.Q_direct: same hidden trunk and budget; one scalar head; predicts x_R=min(X)+sample_SD*o; relative squared x_R loss
training.route_specific_validation: checkpoint selection uses each route's own validation loss and is part of the intervention

classical_reference.role: descriptive external reference; not pooled with neural paired bootstrap

inference.bootstrap: crossed paired resampling: fold within n and global training seed, keeping routes paired
inference.multiplicity: pooled P_equal-Q_param contrast is confirmatory; by-n, region, continuous and Q_direct comparisons are exploratory

execution.resume: a fit is skipped only when metadata and compressed evidence both exist and validate
